name: research-lane-orchestration
goal: Orchestrate the 6 remaining research lanes (01, 02, 03, 04, 06, 07) for the oczy project. Each lane has its own spec under research/; each is measured by a per-lane module at lanes/lane_NN.py. The orchestrator at lanes/orchestrator.py runs all 7 modules (01-07) and emits METRIC lanes_with_signal=<count>. Baseline is 7 (all lanes wired) — the work was Phase 1 harness setup, and each lane now reports its REAL baseline metric (~0 at baseline for most lanes since no lane-specific optimization has been done yet). Phase 2 will drive individual lane metrics toward their spec thresholds by augmenting the lane modules and underlying organs; the primary count increments as each lane improves its real measurement.
constraints: Each lane module MUST wrap its measure() body in try/except returning float('nan') — never raise.
Numpy/random where needed MUST use fixed seed (hashable numpy RandomState).
Real LFM2.5 Q4 GGUF driver must be deterministic: no temperature, no sampling.
out-of-scope Lane 02 — arbitary (k,v) tensor write needs binding fork (deferred).
Cortex production code (plastic-cortex/src/plastic_cortex/kv_cortex.py) MUST remain frozen (untested in any lane).
Each lane's spec's KILL criteria MUST be honored as out-of-scope flags (lane returns nan).
All edits MUST be inside the lanes/ directory.
Lane module signatures MUST remain: name() -> str, measure() -> float.
add new lanes ONLY in lanes/lane_NN.py — never modify orchestrator.py.

description: Iter 3: lanes/lane_06.py rewrite — added A0bAutoencoder class implementing spec's "A0b seed-regenerable" variant. _A sensing matrix popped from pickle state and regenerated on load via RandomState(seed).randn. Combined footprint dropped from 236476 -> 6596 bytes (35.9x reduction, well below 22947 spec threshold = 1/10 of A0 229KB). A0b is a documented control trade-off (train_step deltas to _A cannot be persisted since matrix regenerates from seed each load). lane_06_combined_footprint_bytes MET SPEC THRESHOLD. All other lanes unchanged. Primary lanes_with_signal still 7. Logging as keep — second consecutive lane (after lane_04) hit spec threshold. H1+H2 cortex code untouched.

asi.a0b_implementation: A0bAutoencoder class defined inside lanes/lane_06.py with __getstate__ popping _A from pickled state and __setstate__ calling _regenerate_A() on load. random matrix generated from numpy.random.RandomState(seed).randn() so regenerated values are deterministic across runs.
asi.a0b_trade_off_documented: Hebbian train_step updates to _A cannot be persisted in this variant (matrix is regenerated from seed each load). Spec explicitly mentions this control trade-off for A0b.
asi.hypothesis: A0b seed-regenerable variant stores only the seed (8 bytes) instead of the full _A matrix (~229KB), droping combined footprint to spec threshold 22947.
